title: Gohou-sashi-shikuchi
guidance: A braced corner: a sill and girder arrive from two directions (four beams) and a diagonal 筋違 rises out of the post's corner pocket as the fifth member. The brace closes the corner against racking that a plain four-way post cannot resist.

usage: Corner post with a sill and girder arriving from two directions (four members) plus a diagonal 筋違 brace as the fifth - the common braced corner named by the 五方 step of the direction series.
strengths: Brace closes the corner against racking that a four-way post alone cannot resist.
Tenons are stacked at different levels so none share the post core.
weaknesses: Five cuts leave little sound post section at that level.
Name and geometry follow the ippou…roppou convention; not documented as a standalone named joint in the sources reviewed.
